title: Face Focus
description: Keeps the tracked face clear while softly treating the surrounding image.

parameters.label: Effect
parameters.description: Strength of the treatment outside the tracked face.

parameters.label: Face Area
parameters.description: Size of the clear area around the tracked face.

parameters.label: Desaturate
parameters.description: Colour removed from the surrounding image.

parameters.label: Background Dim
parameters.description: Darkness applied outside the tracked face.

parameters.label: Background Tint
parameters.description: Tint used in the treated background.

parameters.label: Contour
parameters.description: Brightness of the tracked face contour.

parameters.label: Contour Colour
parameters.description: Colour of the tracked face contour.
